results.description:
The morning before an exam, the first day at a new job, a 6 AM flight — some mornings you simply can't sleep through.

AlarmK is a mission-based wake-up alarm built on iOS 26 AlarmKit. Because it uses system-level alarms, it rings through Silent and Focus modes. To dismiss it, you complete a mission — scan a QR code by your bathroom door, solve a math problem, or shake the phone — something that actually requires you to be out of bed.

▶ Why AlarmK
- AlarmKit-based system alarms: same permission model as Apple's Clock app, rings through Silent and Focus
- Mission wake-up: QR/barcode, math, memory, typing, shake, squats, walk, object hunt — 8 missions (chain up to 5, with a practice mode)
- Object hunt: register things around your home, such as the washing machine or kitchen sink, then photograph the ones picked at random when the alarm rings. Checked on your iPhone, never saved
- Deny the system alarm permission and AlarmK won't save an alarm it can't ring — it says why and takes you to Settings
- Wake Report: 7-day wake patterns, mission success rate, streaks

▶ Critical Mode for the mornings that matter
An eight-item night-before checklist: AlarmKit permission, iPhone charging, Silent mode, Focus mode, a saved QR/barcode for this alarm, Apple Watch pairing, a Clock-app backup alarm, and notification permission. iOS gives apps no way to read the ringer switch, and AlarmK doesn't read your Focus status, so those two rows tell you how tomorrow's alarm will be delivered instead. The Clock backup is yours to make — AlarmK never creates one; tick that row once you have. The reliability score counts only rows that settled on a clear pass or fail. Anything not ready says so on the spot.

▶ Live Activity & Dynamic Island
As the alarm gets close, a countdown appears on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island. When it fires, tap the secondary button to jump straight into your mission. The same countdown appears in the Apple Watch Smart Stack.

▶ Widgets · Siri · Shift work
- Home and Lock Screen widgets show your next alarm and countdown
- Siri & Shortcuts: set alarms, check the next one, start a nap timer, skip an occurrence — without opening the app
- Shift rotations (N days on / M days off), optional Korean public-holiday skip, and a fixed-instant option for dated alarms
- An optional bedtime reminder and the wake check guard both ends of the night

▶ iCloud sync
Your alarm definitions sync via your own iCloud (private database). Switch iPhones and your alarms come with you. Your alarm data is never sent to our servers, and we can't see it.

▶ Honest about the limits
- A phone that's powered off, has 0% battery, or has alarm permissions denied — no alarm app can wake you. AlarmK focuses on flagging those risks before they bite.
- If the system alarm permission is denied, AlarmK refuses to save or switch on a new alarm rather than let it fail quietly at 6 AM. Alarms saved before the permission was turned off keep trying as notifications — with the ringer switch on Silent they may make no sound, and a Lock Screen card tells you where you stand.

▶ Privacy
- Camera and motion permissions are used only during missions and object setup
- QR scans are verified on-device, never transmitted
- No third-party analytics — no Google Analytics, no Facebook SDK
- QR secrets sync end-to-end encrypted in your iCloud Keychain (device-only if you turn iCloud Keychain off)

▶ FAQ
Q. What happens if I turn off iCloud?
A. iOS removes the synced alarms from this iPhone, and AlarmK cancels their system alarms. Signing back in to the same account restores alarms that had already synced.

Q. My alarm didn't fire.
A. First check that the system alarm permission, notification permission, and notification sound are all on. Opening the Critical Mode checklist reviews those plus battery and charging, Silent mode and Focus, and points at whatever isn't ready.

THE ALARM IS FREE. FOREVER.
No forced subscription to set or stop an alarm. No ads. No account. Repeat schedules, custom labels, snooze rules you control, a nap timer for quick recharges, and a one tap alarm test that proves your phone will ring.

A SNOOZE CAN NEVER DISMISS.

PRO: THE PART THAT GETS YOU OUT OF BED.
Stack up to three missions that must be completed before the alarm stays quiet:
• Math: three difficulty levels

EVERY MISSION HAS AN ESCAPE HATCH.
Hold ten seconds, type "I give up", and the alarm stops. It always works, even with a broken camera. Rooster makes waking effortful, never impossible.

WAKE CHECK.
Dismissed the alarm and gone back to sleep? Five minutes later Rooster asks "Still up?" If you don't answer, it rings once more. Part of Pro, and on from the start for every new alarm you create with Pro.

HONEST PRICING.

WHY WE DEVELOPED THIS APP:

The planning for this app started when we happened to hear from a nursery school teacher that, "The children always sleep well on rainy days."

Through further investigation, we heard the same thing, not just from other nursery school teachers, but many mothers as well.

But, through what mechanism this was happening by remained unclear. There are various theories, such as an atmospheric pressure theory (it was due to low atmospheric pressure), a light intensity theory (it was due to the sky being dark and cloudy), and a sound theory (it was due to the sound of rain being close to an f/1 tremor).

We decided to focus on the sound theory and added a feature, to a basic alarm clock app that plays sleeping music, such as the sound of rain.

A normal alarm stops when you tap the screen. Awaken is the alarm that won't let you snooze. You can't turn it off from under the covers, and there is no "5 more minutes." You stand up, move, and prove you are awake.

WHO IS AWAKEN FOR
• Heavy sleepers and deep sleepers who sleep through a normal alarm
• Chronic snoozers who hit snooze for an hour
• Anyone who oversleeps and ends up late for work, school or classes
• Students with early lectures and exams
• Early-shift workers
• Anyone building a morning routine that actually starts on time

13 WAKE-UP CHALLENGES
Awaken is an alarm clock challenge app with 13 missions in three groups.

Get out of bed: photo, barcode and mission alarms
• Sky Photo. Photograph real sky from a window or outside. A ceiling does not count.
• Grass Photo. Go outside and photograph real grass.
• Barcode Scan. Walk to a barcode you registered, like your toothpaste or coffee, and scan it.
• Photo Mission. Re-photograph the spot you set the night before. You can't match it from bed.

Move: workout alarms
• Squats. The camera counts your squats until the goal is reached.
• Jumping Jacks. Camera-checked. No faking it from the pillow.
• Dance. Stay in frame and keep moving, or the alarm keeps going.
• Shake Phone. Shake until the bar fills.
• Tap the Screen. Tap the screen a set number of times. Stop short and it keeps ringing.

Think: math and puzzle alarms
• Math Problems. Solve them before you can bargain with yourself.
• Memory Game. Match the pairs. An unfinished game keeps ringing.
• Typing Challenge. Type a sentence accurately. Sleepy typos don't pass.
• Trace Path. Follow the path with your finger to the end.

STACK THEM. RANDOMIZE THEM.
Use one challenge or stack several, like squats plus math. The ringing stops only when every challenge is finished. Random mode picks the challenge for you, so you can't memorize an easy way out. Photo Mission and Barcode Scan join Random once you set them up.

5 minutes after you turn off the alarm, Awaken sends a notification. Open it and a 60-second timer asks if you're up. Don't confirm in time and the alarm rings again.

What's the best alarm for heavy sleepers?
One you can't dismiss half-asleep. Awaken is a loud alarm with no snooze button. It keeps ringing until you complete a wake-up challenge, like photographing the sky or doing squats on camera.

Can I turn off Awaken without getting out of bed?
Not if you pick a get-out-of-bed challenge. Sky Photo, Grass Photo, Barcode Scan and Photo Mission all need you on your feet, and there is no snooze.

Movement and photo challenges, because they get you standing and walking. Pair one with Math Problems or the Memory Game to wake up your brain too.

Can Awaken help me stop oversleeping?
That's what it's built for. When getting up is the only way to stop the ringing, snoozing stops being an option.

Tomorrow morning doesn't get a vote.
